newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain asks CNN to remove website link to ETA.
newsitem.headline: Spain asks CNN to remove website link to ETA.

text.p: The Spanish government has asked U.S. cable television network CNN to remove links between its its website and the site of the Basque guerrilla group ETA, government sources said on Wednesday.
The separatists killed a young Basque town councillor at the weekend, igniting massive demonstrations across Spain which captured headlines around the world.
A spokesman for CNN rejected Spain's request, saying it was standard practice to link up to the website of an organisation directly from a story about it.

"The government has sent a letter to CNN to say ETA is a terrorist organisation and the direct link to it on the internet should be removed," a source in Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar's office told Reuters.

CNN spokesman Steve Haworth said the network would gladly add links to any websites which the Spanish government requested but added: "We don't plan to take off the links that they asked us to take off. We believe more information is better than less."
Spain's leaders have vowed a crackdown on the Basque guerrillas and are trying to isolate their supporters.
